regions.purpose: Identifies the surface and holds Done, which commits the Collection and continues into it, and Cancel, which discards uncommitted changes.
The Collection's own identity — name, description, appearance (color, pin style), and the powerRanking toggle. The only place this metadata is editable.
The Review template — the ordered field set governing every Review in this Collection. Add fields, adopt a built-in template, and edit each field in place.

altAffordances.label: Finish editing (return to map and commit candidate)
altAffordances.note: Same Save affordance as DONE. Fires this alt event when return-to-draft-context is set (editor reached from AddLocationToCollection's TAP_NEW_COLLECTION). The host commits the in-flight candidate Location against the just-created Collection (Location.addToCollection) and emerges in MapOverview with pending-review-context.

affordances.label: Edit the Collection's name, description, appearance, and powerRanking toggle
Adopt a built-in template as a starting point
Cancel (in per-field editor sheet) — discard the in-flight edit
Done (in per-field editor sheet) — commit the edit and close the sheet
Add another (in per-field editor sheet) — commit the current edit and re-open the sheet on a fresh blank field

shows: the field's name (its user-facing section label)
the field's type — score, text, enum, boolean
the field's per-type configuration — for a score field, its range, step, and Display As style (number, stars, icon, slider, bar); for an enum, its option list

affordance.label: Edit, reorder, or remove a field

lockedHeadRow.shows: The implicit date field that every Review captures at the head of the form.
lockedHeadRow.affordance: none — the date row cannot be edited, reordered, or removed from the editor.

lists.emptyState: A template with no user-authored fields — the region prompts the user to add a field or adopt a built-in template. The implicit date row remains. An empty template is a valid (if unusual) end state; a Collection with one leaves ReviewForm with only the date to fill.
